verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo is still public and "free to use, fork, and build on under the LICENSE," but only "as is and without support or warranty." Community reports show Daytona has since gone closed source, so self-hosting appears limited to a frozen, unsupported codebase. An earlier hands-on user did compile and run it, and an install script existed. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting docs for the current product, an actively maintained open-source core, and parity between the self-hostable code and the hosted sandbox platform.
